source: M2-C Phase 7 Final ML Dataset Preparation

landslide_id.description: Unique identifier for each landslide record

ndvi.purpose: Vegetation health indicator from satellite imagery
ndvi.notes: Synthetic demo data - not real measurements

elevation_m.purpose: Terrain height from digital elevation model
elevation_m.notes: Synthetic demo data - not real measurements

slope_deg.notes: Synthetic demo data - not real measurements

aspect_deg.notes: Synthetic demo data - not real measurements

data_source_type.purpose: Distinguishes synthetic/demo data from real observations
data_source_type.notes: CRITICAL: All environmental values in this dataset are synthetic demo values

destination_expected_schema.note: M1 implementation not available for direct inspection. M1 should expect the source schema as defined above.
destination_expected_schema.feature_mapping: Direct 1:1 mapping recommended - no transformation required if M1 accepts this schema

rainfall.handling: Excluded from ML feature dataset (preserved in metadata dataset for reference)
rainfall.reason: Current rainfall demo data lacks spatial coordinates
rainfall.note: M1 must obtain rainfall from an appropriate spatial rainfall source or another properly validated pipeline

target.explanation: No trustworthy supervised learning target available in synthetic/demo dataset
target.note: Severity field preserved in metadata but not used as ML target

synthetic_data.explanation: All environmental feature values (NDVI, elevation, slope, aspect) are synthetic demo values created for pipeline development and testing only. They are NOT real-world measurements and MUST NOT be used as evidence of real-world model performance.

version_information.notes: This contract documents the M2-C → M1 handoff interface. M1 should validate this contract before consuming the dataset.
